This '''person''' was the personal [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nile Owen]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Nak Farool]]. This individual defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] of Owen's [[Nile Owen's daughter|daughter]].
